result.headline: No control-loop fault found; setpoint-led maneuvers tracked with ~1 s lag, but throttle dropped to 0% at 115.6 s unexplained.
result.explanation: Attitude follows the controller setpoint (corr 0.975 at 0.98 s lag) and actuators move with the setpoint, so no control-loop fault shows. The throttle cut at 115.6 s and the low-voltage warning are not explained by this data.

evidence.quote: EVENT t=0.629 s controller.event[mavros: Battery] mavros: Battery: WARN: Low voltage
evidence.shows: The only event in the recording: a low-voltage warning at start. Nothing later correlates with it.

evidence.quote: CHANGE propulsion.throttle at t=115.637 s: 40 -> 0 % (step -40, 20x its usual variation)
evidence.shows: Throttle cut to 0% with no event or failsafe logged. Airspeed fell 18.553 -> 10.281 m/s 0.57 s later (line 52). ch[2] went to 1100 us at 117.0 s (line 32).

evidence.quote: CHANGE control.attitude_setpoint[roll] at t=14.018 s: 44.35 -> -14.84 deg (step -59.19, 204.1x its usual variation)
evidence.shows: Roll setpoint steps of about 60 deg are the large changes in the recording. In the 10-15 s window the roll setpoint left baseline at 10.46 s, then the actuators at 10.481 s, then the roll attitude at 11.643 s. This is command-led, as designed.

evidence.quote: TRACKING control.attitude_setpoint[roll] vs vehicle.attitude[roll]: typical |error| 5.317 deg, worst 45.928 at t=14.844 s; 6 window(s) above 15.951
evidence.shows: Roll tracking error is mostly lag: correlation rises from 0.791 to 0.975 at a 0.977 s lag. Large errors sit on setpoint steps.

evidence.quote: TRACKING control.attitude_setpoint[yaw] vs vehicle.attitude[yaw]: typical |error| 93.375 deg, worst 178.565 at t=72.895 s; 0 window(s) above 280.125
evidence.shows: The yaw error is a large offset. Setpoint median is 274 and attitude median -195, both unwrapped, so it looks like a wrap-offset artifact, not tracking loss. Cannot be confirmed from these signals.

checked.check: Order of departure from baseline around the 10-15 s roll step
checked.result: Setpoint (10.46 s) -> actuators ch3-5 (10.481 s) -> throttle (11.226 s) -> attitude roll (11.643 s). The command leads and the response follows.
checked.about: Attitude estimate or actuator fault as primary

checked.check: Order of departure from baseline around 108-118 s
checked.result: Throttle rose at 109.718 s and actuators moved at 109.941 s. Setpoint roll and attitude followed later (110.483 s and 111.057 s).

checked.check: Roll setpoint vs roll attitude relation
checked.result: Correlation 0.791 at zero lag rises to 0.975 at 0.977 s lag. Typical difference is 5.317 deg, worst 45.928 deg at 14.844 s.
Roll attitude follows the setpoint with a delay (setpoint peak 44.77, attitude peak 50.67). ch[4] and ch[5] are identical across the window.
One event only (low-voltage warning at 0.629 s). No earlier cases match.
